# Ghayur Accounts and Tax Services (GATS)

> Independent, family-run accounting and tax firm in Mississauga, Ontario, established 2001. Corporate (T2) and personal (T1) tax, bookkeeping, payroll, HST/GST, incorporations, and specialist work for licensed childcare centres (CWELCC funding reconciliations), physicians and medical professional corporations, not-for-profits and charities, newcomers and cross-border (Canada, US, UK) individuals, manufacturers, franchises, restaurants and builders. Works remotely with clients across Canada.

- Phone: 647-870-8498
- Email: office@ghayurtax.com
- Office: 100-51 Village Centre Place, Mississauga, ON L4Z 1V9, Canada
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm (Eastern)
- Contact by phone or email; no online booking. Documents are sent through a secure Intuit Link portal, never by email.
- Payment: Interac e-Transfer to office@ghayurtax.com

## Services and specialties

- [Home and services overview](https://www.ghayurtax.com/): personal tax, corporate tax, bookkeeping on QuickBooks Online, payroll and HST, financial reporting, cross-border tax, business advice
- [Childcare operators and CWELCC](https://www.ghayurtax.com/childcare.html): CWELCC cost-based funding reconciliations, spending plans and payroll wage rules for licensed centres in Peel, Halton and Toronto
- [Physicians and medical professional corporations](https://www.ghayurtax.com/medical.html): MPC year-ends, T2s, salary versus dividends, when a physician should incorporate
- [Not-for-profits and charities](https://www.ghayurtax.com/nonprofits.html): fund-tracked bookkeeping, financial statements, T3010 and T1044 returns, HST rebates
- [Newcomers and cross-border](https://www.ghayurtax.com/newcomers.html): first Canadian return, US and UK income, residency, foreign tax credits
- [Incorporation](https://www.ghayurtax.com/incorporation.html): Ontario or federal incorporation prepared and filed by the firm, from CA$799 all-in, including professional corporations

## Free resources

- [Grants, funding and tax credits for Ontario businesses, 2026](https://www.ghayurtax.com/grants.html): programs checked against official pages, by audience, including manufacturers
- [Canadian tax deadlines 2026-2027](https://www.ghayurtax.com/key-dates.html): CRA and Ontario dates with subscribable calendars
- [Deadline tools](https://www.ghayurtax.com/deadline-tools.html): T2 filing, balance-due, instalment and HST due-date calculators from a fiscal year-end
